caption: The drawing features a round, carved object rendered in shades of brown and tan, resembling wood. At the center of the circular design is a bird with outstretched wings and a visible tail, facing slightly to the left, and holding a small branch or twig in its beak. The bird is encircled by a band inside which it is centered. Around this inner band, forming a border close to the outer edge of the circle, there is an arrangement of carved branches or leaves spaced evenly around the circumference. The background is a plain cream or off-white color. Near the lower right of the circular object, below it, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" appears in uppercase letters, spaced out and printed in brown ink.
title: Butter Mold
